# Police Lines School & College, Faridpur — 65 Years Grand Reunion 2027

> Official bilingual (Bengali & English) portal for the 65th anniversary Grand Reunion 2027 of Police Lines School and College, Faridpur, Bangladesh (Est. 1962), hosted at https://www.plscf65.online/.

## Event Details

- **Institution**: Police Lines School and College, Faridpur (Est. 1962)
- **Event**: 65th Anniversary Grand Reunion 2027
- **Dates**: January 28 – 29, 2027
- **Venue**: School Campus & Police Lines Large Field, Kamlapur, Faridpur Sadar, Faridpur-7800, Bangladesh

## Public Pages

- `https://www.plscf65.online/` — Official Reunion Portal homepage, countdown, committee overview, and event summary
- `https://www.plscf65.online/register` — Alumni and current student online registration form
- `https://www.plscf65.online/donate` — Contribution and alumni welfare donation portal
- `https://www.plscf65.online/international-payment` — International remittance support for overseas alumni
- `https://www.plscf65.online/notices` — Official notices and event announcements
- `https://www.plscf65.online/gallery` — Campus heritage photo and video archive
- `https://www.plscf65.online/about` — Institutional history, 65th anniversary objectives, and secretariat helpdesk contact

## Privacy Notice

Private administrative dashboards, gate/food verification stations, and individual attendee ticket records are excluded from search indexing.
